summary: Short, proof-led UK page: a dark hero with a portrait on a colour panel and a solution finder bar across its lower edge, a logo band under a big trust figure, a solution browser with vertical tabs, three customer stories, three articles and a contact form beside a chevron photo. Needs client logos, reviews or articles to reach five sections.

sections.note: slate ground: small audience line, two-colour heading (first line in a light accent), lead left; a smiling portrait on a rounded brand-colour panel with three small white UI cards over its edges right; a finder bar with Industry, Size and Looking for selects and a search button overlaps the hero's lower edge
centered heading built on one large trust figure, one centered line, then a scrolling row of client logos

centered heading; vertical tabs left (by business area, by business size, by industry) with an accent bar under the active one; a raised white panel right with a two-column grid of six cards, each with a picture slot, a coloured title, a paragraph and a See more link
centered heading and line, three columns each with a video poster or photo on top, the quote in bold and the name with job title, a centered link to all stories below
centered heading, three white article cards with a photo, a small caps category tag, the title, an excerpt and a pill button

pale band: a smiling headset photo cut into a chevron pointing right at the left edge with a Call us now pill on its tip, heading across the top, a sub-heading and a two-column enquiry form (name, job title, company, email, phone, company size) right
centered two-line statement and a faded paragraph that opens with a Read more link on a thin rule
